request.text: A fire burns low in the grey before dawn. Someone sits by it, waiting for you to wake. You wake on cold ground beside a fire. You don't remember lying down. An old man sits across the flames, propped against a log. His face is grey, and his breath rattles. The fire pops. The old man is dead.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 40-50. Excellent quality. Persona: a storyteller at a fire, telling an old tale to one listener. Emotion: calm, warm, quietly grave. A low, clear, unhurried voice with a soft warmth, close to the listener but never intimate; even and steady, so it can speak for hours without tiring the ear.
